newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - National Assembly to cast preliminary vote for constitutional reforms.
Southeast Asian currencies founder amid heavy speculation.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Cambodia's Second Prime Minister Hun Sen accuses Taiwan general of meddling in Cambodia's recent fighting.
Bill Gates repeats as world's wealthiest entrepreneur.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui asks National Assembly members to support constitutional reforms.
Hun Sen says will consider direct links with Taiwan.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central bank says will adjust monetary policy "at appropriate time".
Former U.S. senator and presidential nominee Bob Dole to come to Taiwan to deliver speech.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government reactions mixed toward stock market bull run.
Government to consider loosening daily seven percent limit for rises and falls in stock market.
